purpose: Print detail of the looks robot approved at N1: the mechanism re-laid out to fit inside the unchanged look at S 0.65
pass_criterion: It walks on its 8 legs inside the approved look, with every part inside the body (no box left out) and min gap >= 0 over the 24 poses
must_have: the approved N1 look at S 0.65: jenscolt body, eyes and base, his legs on N0's path, high knees
one N10 3 V gear motor and 6 x AG13 wired 2S3P (3 V), a switch, no microcontroller
two eye bores for the 5 mm LEDs from the Arduino kit; no eyes board (Morante wires them)
every part fits inside with every box placed: motor, clamp, gears, cell packs, switch, wires
every part prints with <= 10 % support and none on a functional face (Bambu P2S, PLA)
must_not: a scale above S 0.65 to solve a fit (ceiling S 0.70; change placement, toy's own layout first)

S_max.source: Morante 2026-11-19: ceiling, never grown to fix a fit

body_wall.source: D4a, cad/robot/design-plan.md (1.6 = D4b still a candidate)

views.note: views.py is written by the cad-designer: the N2 meshes in n1_render's four views (3/4, front, side, below-front), no labels on the robot
